description: An easy-to-use appearance preset switcher for Virt-A-Mate (Desktop and VR). Organize your character appearances into subfolders within 'Saves/Person/appearance' (e.g., Male, Female). Each folder automatically becomes a separate Lookset collection. Select a target character and smoothly cycle through looks or switch collections using UI buttons or customizable hotkeys while keeping your character's scene name and links intact.
instructions:
1. Place your saved appearance presets into subfolders inside 'Saves/Person/appearance' (each subfolder acts as a separate Lookset).
2. Open Main Menu -> Session Plugins, click Add Plugin, and load CircleLooks.cs.
3. Click 'Save As Default' so the plugin automatically loads into every scene.
4. Select a Target Person and use UI buttons or hotkeys (Default: L for Next Look, K for Prev Look, O for Cycle Lookset, P for Cycle Person).
